metadata.name: D1
metadata.description: the dense ECS interior (doctrine #2): ONE cel holding the whole 10k flock as SoA Float32Arrays {n, positions(3N), velocities(3N)}. Seeded by the pump's flockSeed init (the doc ships no floats); the buffer schema makes user saves round-trip the typed arrays as b64.

metadata.name: D2
metadata.description: the sparse boundary: the ONLY per-frame value that crosses the graph. The pump bumps it; the D4 sceneframe re-fires; scene.paint drains dirty instances into the retained InstancedMesh.

metadata.name: D3
metadata.description: the params object the sim reads - re-derives on every edit of the B-column knobs (and D5 embeds it, so the pump sees the fresh object next frame). maxNeighbors is the aggregation cap that used to be a hidden native constant.

cels.f: ={cohesion: B2, alignment: B3, separation: B4, maxSpeed: B5, radius: B6, dt: B7, w: B8, h: B9, d: B10, maxNeighbors: B15}

metadata.name: D4
metadata.description: the scene.paint channel cel: {key, gen} per generation bump - how the sim paints WITHOUT routing 30,000 floats through the vnode diff.

metadata.name: D5
metadata.description: pump config → what sim.run reads. THE RULE IS ON THE SHEET: kernel picks the steering lambda - the wat tier (B20 source, B21 binder → boids10k.steerwat) above 2000 fish, the legible B19 =LAMBDA below. fn/kernel/init are CEL REFERENCES (never strings): edit B19 or B20 mid-swim and the flock changes course. swarmstep is pure mechanism - spatial hash + neighbor aggregates + integrate + wrap; it has no rule of its own.

cels.f:
={while: 'win.boids10k.state', fps: B11,
	effects: [{fn: swarmstep, kernel: IF(B12 > 2000, boids10k.steerwat, B19),
		buffers: 'boids10k.D1', params: D3, gen: 'boids10k.D2',
		init: flockSeed, initArgs: [B12, B13, B8, B9, B10]}]}

metadata.name: C5

cels.v: pump → what sim.run reads (D5): the STEERING RULE is the kernel cell it references - B19 (legible =LAMBDA) under 2000 fish, the B20 wat source (compiled via the B21 binder) above. Every knob on the left is live; count/seed are SEED-time (clear D1 to reseed).

metadata.name: A14

metadata.name: B14
metadata.description: reader note: the dense-tier doctrine — one cel, many entities; the rule stays native for the buffer march, and the formula-tier twin (same three steering terms) is the 2D boids doc's D6

cels.v: the rule lives ON THE SHEET, in the stack below: B19 is the steering =LAMBDA (aggregates in, velocity out); B20 is the same rule as wat source, compiled by the =WAT binder in B21 into boids10k.steerwat - same ABI, ~20x faster, which is what 10,000 fish at 30fps need. Edit either rule mid-swim. Native swarmstep is mechanism only: spatial hash, neighbor means, integrate, wrap. Compile the rule, don't fuse it.

metadata.name: B19
metadata.description: THE STEERING RULE, legible tier: an infix =LAMBDA over the swarmstep kernel ABI - (px,py,pz, vx,vy,vz, n, cx,cy,cz, ax,ay,az, sx,sy,sz, coh, ali, sep, maxv) -> [vx,vy,vz]. n = neighbors found, c* = neighbor centroid, a* = mean neighbor velocity, s* = separation sum. EDIT ME with count ≤ 2000 and the flock changes course mid-swim; B20 is the same rule compiled to wat (minted by the B21 binder), which the pump uses at 10k.

cels.f:
=LAMBDA(px,py,pz, vx,vy,vz, n, cx,cy,cz, ax,ay,az, sx,sy,sz, coh, ali, sep, maxv,
	LET(
		wx, IF(n>0, vx + (cx-px)*coh + (ax-vx)*ali + sx*sep, vx),
		wy, IF(n>0, vy + (cy-py)*coh + (ay-vy)*ali + sy*sep, vy),
		wz, IF(n>0, vz + (cz-pz)*coh + (az-vz)*ali + sz*sep, vz),
		speed, MAX(0.000001, SQRT(wx*wx + wy*wy + wz*wz)),
		k, MIN(MAX(speed, maxv*0.3), maxv)/speed,
		[wx*k, wy*k, wz*k]))

metadata.name: B20
metadata.description: THE STEERING RULE, compiled tier: the same rule as B19 in WebAssembly text - identical ABI, identical output, ~20x the call rate, which is what 10,000 fish need. EDIT ME: the B21 binder recompiles it and the pump picks up the new rule next frame, mid-swim. (The cell is an infix formula returning the source string - the ='...' wrapper keeps a leading '(' from reading as an s-expr on commit, so bar edits round-trip.)

cels.f:
='(module (func (export "main")
  (param $px f64) (param $py f64) (param $pz f64)
  (param $vx f64) (param $vy f64) (param $vz f64)
  (param $n f64)
  (param $cx f64) (param $cy f64) (param $cz f64)
  (param $ax f64) (param $ay f64) (param $az f64)
  (param $sx f64) (param $sy f64) (param $sz f64)
  (param $coh f64) (param $ali f64) (param $sep f64) (param $maxv f64)
  (result f64 f64 f64)
  (local $wx f64) (local $wy f64) (local $wz f64) (local $speed f64) (local $k f64)
  (if (f64.gt (local.get $n) (f64.const 0))
    (then
      (local.set $wx (f64.add (local.get $vx) (f64.add (f64.mul (f64.sub (local.get $cx) (local.get $px)) (local.get $coh)) (f64.add (f64.mul (f64.sub (local.get $ax) (local.get $vx)) (local.get $ali)) (f64.mul (local.get $sx) (local.get $sep))))))
      (local.set $wy (f64.add (local.get $vy) (f64.add (f64.mul (f64.sub (local.get $cy) (local.get $py)) (local.get $coh)) (f64.add (f64.mul (f64.sub (local.get $ay) (local.get $vy)) (local.get $ali)) (f64.mul (local.get $sy) (local.get $sep))))))
      (local.set $wz (f64.add (local.get $vz) (f64.add (f64.mul (f64.sub (local.get $cz) (local.get $pz)) (local.get $coh)) (f64.add (f64.mul (f64.sub (local.get $az) (local.get $vz)) (local.get $ali)) (f64.mul (local.get $sz) (local.get $sep)))))))
    (else
      (local.set $wx (local.get $vx))
      (local.set $wy (local.get $vy))
      (local.set $wz (local.get $vz))))
  (local.set $speed (f64.max (f64.const 0.000001)
    (f64.sqrt (f64.add (f64.mul (local.get $wx) (local.get $wx)) (f64.add (f64.mul (local.get $wy) (local.get $wy)) (f64.mul (local.get $wz) (local.get $wz)))))))
  (local.set $k (f64.div (f64.min (f64.max (local.get $speed) (f64.mul (local.get $maxv) (f64.const 0.3))) (local.get $maxv)) (local.get $speed)))
  (f64.mul (local.get $wx) (local.get $k))
  (f64.mul (local.get $wy) (local.get $k))
  (f64.mul (local.get $wz) (local.get $k))
))'

manifests.name: boids10k
manifests.description: 10,000 fish, formula-first (a sheetapp document) - the WHOLE 3-D boids sim lives in visible grid cells, INCLUDING THE RULE: params in B2:B15, the steering =LAMBDA in B19, the same rule as wat source in B20 compiled by the =WAT binder in B21 (the pump picks a tier by flock size), the SoA buffer cel in D1 probed by =bufstats in B16, the generation boundary in D2, the params object in D3, the sceneframe channel in D4, and the pump config in D5 under the plastron-gpu InstancedMesh scene grown by =view() in A1.
